scenarios.name: War Escalation
scenarios.reasoning: Increased geopolitical uncertainty and risk aversion would likely lead to a sharp sell-off in equities as investors seek safer assets. The S&P 500 would likely break below its key support level of 7,275.89 due to panic selling.

scenarios.name: Fed Pivot
scenarios.reasoning: An unexpected rate cut signals a dovish stance and injects liquidity, boosting investor confidence and risk appetite. The S&P 500 would likely rally past its key resistance level of 7,816.70 as lower borrowing costs make equities more attractive.

scenarios.name: Liquidity Crunch / Flash Crash
scenarios.reasoning: Forced liquidations can create a cascading effect, leading to rapid and severe price declines as sellers overwhelm buyers. The S&P 500 could experience a significant drawdown, potentially falling well below its current support and even approaching levels not seen in years.

D.hedging_suggestion: Consider implementing put options on the S&P 500 or a broad market ETF to protect against significant downside risk.
